codelines.name: gotransit
codelines.reason: Owns the Go-Checkout page's email/confirm-email fields and the case-sensitive equality check that causes the reported mismatch.
codelines.evidence: src/components/pages/CheckoutPage/CheckoutForm.tsx:306 — confirmEmail field's `validate` rule reads `if (email && value && value !== email) { return t("TRM774"); }`, a case-sensitive string comparison between the confirmEmail and email fields

facts.text: Tests run via `npm test` (jest); CheckoutForm's confirm-email validation is covered by src/components/pages/CheckoutPage/__tests__/CheckoutForm.spec.tsx, which already exercises the confirmEmail field.
The pre-commit hook rejects any commit unless the current branch name matches `^(feature|bugfix|tech|release|hotfix)\/[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+(\/[a-z0-9-]+)?$`, and also runs `npx lint-staged`.
